major_name: English and Graphic and Information Design
college: College of Social Sciences and Humanities
overview_text: The Department of English and the Department of Art + Design offer an interdisciplinary combined major in English and graphic and information design. Students interested in the combined major in English and graphic and information design integrate the study of literature and writing with the design of message and meaning, integrating text, image, and data.
